resources.string: Sleeps on Android network callbacks and performs one guarded Tailscale restart after a stable physical-network handover.

The low-priority foreground notification keeps the callbacks registered. There is no polling, scheduled job, alarm, shell monitor, or wake lock. The Shizuku UserService exists only for a restart transaction.
